title: Best Protein Powder (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from the Consumer Reports safety study, the MensHealth review of Ritual, and the Best Protein Powder guide that lists Clean Simple Eats, Premier Protein, and Truvani.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no cost information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a vegan athlete who wants a clean, plant‑based protein that tastes like vanilla cake. Ritual delivers pea protein with a sweetener system that keeps it smooth and free of heavy metals, making it a reliable choice for those who avoid dairy. The catch: it has slightly less protein per scoop than some whey isolates.
